speaker: jacqueline_field
text: You said good night, and the chair did not take it. The leaf is open on your knee. I am not asking the question again.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: She is where I left her this morning. I am reading, and I am not adding a line.

speaker: richard_field
text: Then read. One fire. It does not set type, and it will not follow thee. I am not walking thee to the corner while the leaf is open.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It will shut as it is. Nothing under the question. I am not standing up to promise you a book.

speaker: jacqueline_field
text: Non. The cups can wait until you have gone. Sit, if you are not writing. I did not come back into the room for a second plot.
